instruments.ICT-2006: Information and Communication Technology Act 2006 (as amended)

principles: authorization-first: every offensive capability requires a written-authorization warrant record
osint-public-only: intelligence gathering limited to publicly available artifacts
official-channels-only: victim complaints route exclusively to BTRC and Cyber Police
fail-closed: any gate failure aborts the operation; no silent degradation
audit-everything: every mutating action appends to the HMAC hash-chained audit log
no-auto-filing: generated complaints are drafts requiring human review
data-minimization: no raw PII in audit payloads, hashes only
